title: Shell of the explorer over a made-up history: the bar and the shared pieces

states.title: The bar at the tip of a branch: five categories, Pages active, the commit field at the tip, Go to tip disabled
The Modules destination shows six scoped category tabs.
The Types category keeps Modules active and the branch revision scope.
The bar at a selected earlier commit: Functions active, the tip and the viewed hash told apart, Go to tip offered
The bar after Go to tip, back, a reload, forward and another branch chosen from the keyboard
The shared pieces: the bar without an address, breadcrumbs, the icon set, the two looks of a verdict, actions, tabs and the shared classes, with two rows of the console that was outside the explorer
The shared pieces with the tooltip of a verdict that did not pass open: its status and its reasons, inside the screen
The shared pieces after both actions were pressed, another tab was chosen and the switch was turned on
The shared pieces with the last tab of each row shown after the screen changed its width: the tab is whole in its strip, and the page is no wider than the screen
The search of the bar with results of every category of the revision in view, the first one active
